label: fully secure XDCR replication
type: the XDCR security level that puts both authentication and data transfer over TLS. Configured on the reference, in one of two credential shapes: username, password and the target's root certificate; or root certificate plus client certificate and client private key (client-certificate authentication).
evidence: A _fully_ secure replication handles both authentication and data-transfer via TLS.
This procedure requires access to the root certificate for the destination cluster.
The source cluster can authenticate with the target by means _either_ of a username and password _or_ of its own client certificate.
This root certificate (or _CA_) must be included in the _trust store_ of the target cluster.
note: Promoted with xdcr:half-secure-replication as the two named levels of the same setting. The dependency that only the administration tree states: the cluster encryption level `strict` REQUIRES all XDCR replications to be fully secure first - a precondition on a cluster-wide TLS setting owned by a per-reference XDCR setting, stated on manage-tls.md and nowhere in the XDCR reference tree.
